How I work
01 / AI

Working with AI

I turn a broad question into a brief, work through alternatives with AI, and refine the output into something people can use.

02 / SYSTEMS

Keeping context connected

Learning from real work

The person behind the work

Nika Khutsurauli

AI Operator
Founder & Editor, ILLUMINISMO

History. Operations.
New possibilities.

My background brings together history, media analysis and hands-on logistics. I’m interested in how people make sense of information — and what we can build when those connections become visible.

I helped build TransGeorgia from its earliest dispatching days and supported its growth. I also prepared training materials and trained the after-hours team.

Now I bring that experience into AI-assisted research, practical tools and creative production. I’m open to projects, roles and collaborations where curiosity can turn into useful work.
